# C-EQ 3.7 — Per-app setting, Portuguese and original skins

## ✨ New / Novedades / Novidades
- **Per-app setting**: in Options → Per-app setting, pick an app and a preset (for example Spotify with "Extra bass" and your podcast app with "Podcast"). While that app is playing, the preset is added on top of your device's curve, so your headphone correction stays. It needs the "What's playing" access to know which app is playing. / **Ajuste por app**: un preajuste que se suma a la curva del equipo mientras suena esa app. / **Ajuste por app**: uma predefinição que se soma à curva do aparelho enquanto esse app toca.
- **Portuguese**: the whole app now follows the phone's language in Portuguese too, besides English and Spanish. / **La app en portugués.** / **O app em português.**
- **Five original C-EQ skins**: Carmelita, Cobre, Neón, Fósforo and Hielo, included in the app and also as `.wsz` files in the [skins folder](https://github.com/CarmelitaSoftworks/C-EQ/tree/main/skins) for any classic player. / **Cinco skins originales de C-EQ**, incluidos y como `.wsz`. / **Cinco skins originais do C-EQ**, incluídas e como `.wsz`.
